blurb: Guests cruise aboard two identical 113-foot modern yachts licensed by Transport Canada, hosting up to 280 guests. The yachts feature a main deck with a fully equipped bar and climate-controlled interior, and an upper deck with 360-degree views of the Toronto skyline. Amenities include modern sound and lighting systems, lounge and dining areas, and full washroom facilities.
